raw_market.description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between ZOTIX and GoldRashers in the ESEA Advanced Europe Regular Season, initially scheduled for August 21, 2026 at 3:20 PM ET. This market is decided solely by the round score of Map 1 of this match, and is independent of which team wins Map 1 or the overall match.

This market will resolve to "ZOTIX" if ZOTIX wins Map 1 by 4 or more rounds, including any overtime (i.e. ZOTIX's round total on Map 1 exceeds GoldRashers's by 4 or more). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "GoldRashers".

If Map 1 is completed in this way, the market resolves on that round score regardless of how the remainder of the match concludes (including any later forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead, including video evidence.
